name: 5 seconds
value: LENGTH: The video is 5 seconds long, so the description runs to about 75 words. Write at least 5 sentences. Each one is a full sentence that ends with a full stop. Give each of these its own sentence, in this order: the style and the overall light; the subject and exactly what it is wearing; the colours and materials of the nearest object; the first thing the subject does; what the camera does, worded so it ends with one of the four exact phrases from rule 5. Keep going until every one of them has its own sentence, and do not stop early. If the IDEA gave you words to say, the spoken line goes in as well, in the shape rule 4 asked for.
